frozen_candidates.statement: For every common proper pendant cluster C, K(T,T') = K(T|C,T'|C)+K(T/C,T'/C)-1.
For every common 3-chain (x1,x2,x3), deletion of x3 preserves ordinary unaugmented rooted MAF optimum.
